newsitem.title: USA: Hershey sees modest EPS dilution from Leaf.
newsitem.headline: Hershey sees modest EPS dilution from Leaf.

text.p: Hershey Foods Corp chairman Kenneth Wolfe said Tuesday its newly-acquired Leaf North America operations, bought from Huhtamaki Oy, initially will cause "modest" earnings per share dilution.

But he added Hershey was confident it could significantly improve the operating perfomance of the newly acquired business although considerable time and effort will be required to integrate it with the company's North American confectionary business.
Commenting on the company's record fourth quarter net sales and higher net income, Wolfe said, "We had a good finish to 1996."
He said the company enters 1997 on solid footing, adding the company will continue to introduce new products and invest in its core businesses.
